message.content: Based on the conversation, Gavriel expresses a preference for turn-based combat. This preference stems from the satisfaction it brings in strategic planning and the tension that builds with each decision. He enjoys the depth it offers in battles and finds it particularly appealing when combined with RPG elements and social simulation, as seen in games like "Persona 5 Royal." Gavriel also appreciates the strategic nature of battles, mentioning the elemental weaknesses and the enjoyment of outsmarting opponents. However, he acknowledges the appeal of real-time strategy as well, indicating a balanced interest in both types of combat systems.
